title: Candlelit Gothic Reflection
description: A blonde woman in an elaborate dark blue corset dress stands holding a lit candle in a gothic cathedral at night, while another version of her kneels on the stone floor. To the right, a man in a white suit holds a large transparent bubble containing two mirrored images of the woman facing each other, surrounded by numerous lit candles on the floor.
